findings.explanation: This clause requires me to perform unspecified additional work requested by the client for free, which can lead to unlimited unpaid labor and severely impact my profit margins.
findings.suggested_change: Delete this clause or replace it with a provision stating that any additional services requested by the client must be agreed upon in a written change order with separate compensation.

findings.quoted_text: [CLIENT_NAME] may request unlimited revisions until [CLIENT_NAME] is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: Offering unlimited revisions traps me in an indefinite feedback loop where the client can demand constant changes and subjective perfection without additional pay.
findings.suggested_change: Limit the number of included revision rounds to a fixed amount (such as two rounds) and state that any additional revisions will be billed at an hourly or project rate.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a couple of quick points to discuss before moving forward. - Regarding the relevant clause on additional services, requiring uncompensated extra work can create scheduling challenges. I propose replacing this with a provision requiring a written change order and separate compensation for extra services. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning revisions, an indefinite feedback process makes it difficult to manage the scope. I propose limiting the included revision rounds to a fixed amount, with further changes billed accordingly. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Best regards,
